work_items.title: Pure ZoneService.Contains (haversine circle + ray-casting polygon) + exhaustive unit tests
work_items.goal: The novel geometry primitive. A pure Common/Geo/ZoneService with Contains(Zone zone, double lat, double lng) -> bool: haversine great-circle distance <= RadiusMeters for Circle zones; ray-casting point-in-polygon for Polygon zones (Polygon is jsonb JsonDocument holding [[lat,lng],...]; parse in memory - never project a JsonDocument in LINQ, CLAUDE.md WI-10). No DbContext, no IO - a static/stateless helper so every consumer (matching service, zone-restricted inputs) shares one implementation. Unit-tested with Czech coordinates only, including points ON an edge and just inside/outside.
acceptance_criteria: ZoneService.Contains handles Circle zones via haversine: a point whose great-circle distance to (CenterLat, CenterLng) is <= RadiusMeters returns true; a point just outside returns false. It handles Polygon zones via ray-casting over the [[lat,lng],...] array parsed from the jsonb JsonDocument in memory (the JsonDocument is never passed to a LINQ-to-SQL Select - CLAUDE.md). A null/empty Polygon or a null RadiusMeters for the wrong shape returns false (guard, not exception).

Unit tests use Kutna Hora / Kolin coordinates only and cover: center-inside, just-inside and just-outside a circle radius; a point inside a convex polygon; a point outside; and a point ON a polygon edge / on a circle boundary (AC#1 'pickup on a zone edge' - the chosen boundary convention is asserted and documented in a test comment).

ZoneService_CircleCenter_Contains, ZoneService_CircleJustOutside_Excludes, ZoneService_CircleOnBoundary_DocumentedConvention, ZoneService_PolygonInside_Contains, ZoneService_PolygonOutside_Excludes, and ZoneService_PolygonOnEdge_DocumentedConvention pass.

work_items.title: Zones CRUD /api/v1/zones (FleetAdmin, Circle or Polygon <=200 pts, tenant-scoped)
work_items.goal: Vertical-slice CRUD over the existing Zone entity (verified: Id, FleetId, Name, Shape Circle/Polygon, CenterLat/Lng, RadiusMeters?, Polygon jsonb JsonDocument?, IsEnabled; DbSet already registered). Per-shape validation: Circle requires CenterLat/Lng + RadiusMeters > 0 and Polygon null; Polygon requires a Polygon of 3..200 [lat,lng] pairs and RadiusMeters null. Writing the jsonb Polygon uses JsonDocument.Parse of the request's coordinate array; dispose per CLAUDE.md. POST/PUT zones (FleetAdmin, tenant-scoped) validate per shape: Circle -> CenterLat/Lng present + RadiusMeters > 0 + Polygon null; Polygon -> 3..200 coordinate pairs + RadiusMeters null. work_items.title: Replace pricing/quote with the real matching service (POST, precedence, Meter, at?, widened policy) + pure RouteMatcher + seed example + night route
work_items.goal: The novel backend core. A pure Common/Pricing/RouteMatcher that, given the fleet's candidate routes + zones (loaded in memory - jsonb Polygon not projected, CLAUDE.md), the pickup/dropoff coords, and an evaluation time, applies precedence PointToPoint -> ZoneToZone -> Zone (within a type: highest Priority, then lowest price), using ZoneService.Contains (A3) + the A1 radii/IsBidirectional, and validity (ValidDays bitmask + ValidFromTime/ValidToTime windows that MAY WRAP MIDNIGHT) evaluated in Europe/Prague. Then REPLACE the existing GET CustomerOnly QuoteEndpoint with POST pricing/quote { pickupLat, pickupLng, dropoffLat?, dropoffLng?, at? }: matched -> { type:'Fixed', priceCzk, routeId, routeName }; else dropoff known -> OSRM via IGeoProvider -> tariff max(Minimum, Base + PerKm*km) rounded UP to 10 -> { type:'Estimate', lowCzk, highCzk (+-10% rounded to 10), distanceKm, durationMin }; else -> { type:'Meter', tariff summary }. Widen policy to any-authenticated + anonymous-by-slug (mirror routes/common fleet-by-slug). Seed AC#2 example routes (KH station->center Fixed 100; anywhere-in-KH Fixed 110; KH<->Kolin Fixed 300 both directions via IsBidirectional) and the AC#5 night route valid only 03:00-04:00 in DevelopmentSeeder. NOTE: routes/common stays the canonical public valid-now listing (no rename, no duplicate routes/available - documented in decisions.md).
acceptance_criteria: RouteMatcher is pure (no DbContext/IO): inputs are the in-memory candidate routes + zones + pickup/dropoff + an evaluation DateTimeOffset; it returns a match (routeId, routeName, priceCzk) or null. Precedence is PointToPoint -> ZoneToZone -> Zone; within a type it picks highest Priority then lowest price. ZoneToZone honours IsBidirectional (from->to OR to->from). Validity uses the ValidDays bitmask AND a time window that correctly WRAPS MIDNIGHT (e.g. 22:00-06:00 includes 23:30 and 02:00 but not 12:00), all evaluated in Europe/Prague.

AC#1 unit tests on RouteMatcher pass: RouteMatcher_OverlappingRoutes_PrecedenceAndPriorityWin (two matching routes of different types -> PointToPoint chosen; same type -> higher Priority then lower price), RouteMatcher_ZoneToZone_BidirectionalMatchesBothDirections, RouteMatcher_NightWindow_WrapsMidnight, and RouteMatcher_PickupOnZoneEdge_UsesZoneServiceConvention.

POST pricing/quote replaces the former GET. Request is a JSON body { pickupLat, pickupLng, dropoffLat?, dropoffLng?, at? } (POST body sidesteps the cs-CZ double query-binding trap, CLAUDE.md; a validator bounds coords and rejects a malformed body with 400). The endpoint loads the fleet's enabled/non-deleted routes + zones in memory, calls RouteMatcher at (at ?? now): match -> 200 { type:'Fixed', priceCzk, routeId, routeName }; else dropoff known -> IGeoProvider.RouteAsync -> tariff Max(Minimum, round UP to 10 of Base + PerKm*km) -> 200 { type:'Estimate', lowCzk, highCzk, distanceKm, durationMin } with lowCzk < highCzk always; else -> 200 { type:'Meter', tariff summary }. CRITICAL: the matcher runs BEFORE the dropoff-known branch and MUST run even when dropoff is null (a Zone route matches on pickup-in-zone alone -> AC#2 'anywhere in KH' Fixed 110 has NO dropoff). Do NOT inherit the old QuoteEndpoint's 'if (toLat.HasValue && toLng.HasValue)' guard that only matched when a dropoff was present - that is the opposite of what Zone matching needs. An OSRM failure returns 502 Geo.RouteUnavailable.

Policy is widened: pricing/quote allows any authenticated role (Customer/Driver/Dispatcher/FleetAdmin) AND anonymous-with-slug (the Otestovat panel is dispatcher-facing; the customer home is anonymous). The fleet is resolved by the tenant middleware (JWT claim or X-Fleet-Slug) and the read is query-filter-scoped; no fleet resolved -> 400. A cross-tenant request only ever prices from the caller's fleet routes/tariff.

AC#2 integration tests against seeded data pass: Quote_KHStationToCenter_ReturnsFixed100, Quote_AnywhereInKH_ReturnsFixed110, Quote_KHToKolin_ReturnsFixed300_BothDirections, Quote_KolinToPrague_ReturnsEstimateRange, Quote_OutsideAllZonesNoDropoff_ReturnsMeter. The DevelopmentSeeder is updated so these hold AND an extra route valid only 03:00-04:00 is seeded for AC#5. Quote_CrossTenant_UsesCallerFleetOnly (tenant isolation), Quote_Anonymous_BySlug_Returns200, Quote_Dispatcher_Returns200, and Quote_OsrmDown_Returns502 pass.

work_items.goal: The forced client migration: pricing/quote changed from GET CustomerOnly QuoteResponse(PriceType, FixedPriceCzk, EstimateLowCzk, EstimateHighCzk) to POST any-role { type:'Fixed', priceCzk, routeId, routeName } | { type:'Estimate', lowCzk, highCzk, distanceKm, durationMin } | { type:'Meter', ... }. Update client.ts (pricingQuote -> POST body; PriceQuoteResponse discriminated union with the new fields), usePriceQuote, the pure priceQuote.ts interpretQuote (add a Meter branch -> kind:'meter'; keep the estimate-never-a-single-number invariant; carry routeId/distanceKm), and PriceRangeBadge (render Meter -> 'Podle taximetru'). Verify the driver PriceBadge (priceBadgeUtils already has a Meter case) and FixedPriceBadge still render for the real shapes (AC#6 driver-badge regression). Mirror A6's QuoteResponse exactly.
acceptance_criteria: client.ts pricingQuote becomes a POST to /pricing/quote with a JSON body { pickupLat, pickupLng, dropoffLat?, dropoffLng?, at? } (numbers in the body - no cs-CZ string-parsing needed, CLAUDE.md); PriceQuoteResponse is a discriminated union on type: Fixed (priceCzk, routeId, routeName), Estimate (lowCzk, highCzk, distanceKm, durationMin), Meter (tariff summary fields). The X-Fleet-Slug header is still attached for the anonymous path.

priceQuote.ts interpretQuote gains a { kind:'meter' } branch and carries routeId (Fixed) + distanceKm/durationMin (Estimate); the estimate invariant (lowCzk < highCzk, never a single exact number, AC#4) is preserved. priceQuote.test.ts asserts Fixed -> pevna cena, Estimate -> a RANGE (never one number), and Meter -> the meter view.

PriceRangeBadge renders all three: Fixed 'Cena {n} Kc - pevna', Estimate 'Odhad {low}-{high} Kc', Meter 'Podle taximetru'. The driver PriceBadge (priceBadgeUtils) and FixedPriceBadge continue to render Fixed/Estimate/Meter (AC#6 driver-badge regression). New i18n keys land in both cs.json and en.json (formal 'vy' for customer copy).

Spec Lane-B item 6 clause 2 ('zone-restricted inputs validate against real zones'): the UC-004 RouteOrderPage shipped Zone/ZoneToZone ordering as a pre-06 placeholder. Un-stub it here by routing the in-zone pickup/dropoff through the migrated POST pricing/quote - a Zone route only yields a Fixed quote when the entered pickup is in the zone (and dropoff in the to-zone for ZoneToZone), so pricing/quote IS the zone-validation mechanism (no separate client-side polygon check; ZoneService containment is authoritative server-side). When the quote does not return the expected Fixed route for a Zone order, the customer sees a plain-Czech 'mimo zonu' message rather than a silent wrong price.

notes: UC-006 = 7 Lane A (api) WIs (A1..A7) + 5 Lane B (web) WIs (B1..B4 + E2E) = 12 total. Array is topologically ordered and acyclic. Schema shape matches the operative UC-004 handoff (per-WI: id, lane [api|web], title, goal, depends_on, estimated_complexity XS/S/M/L/XL, files_touched, rule_citations, required_reads, needs_library_research, acceptance_criteria, verification {tool, filter}). verification.tool enum used: dotnet-test | vitest | playwright; dotnet-test filter is a single-token FullyQualifiedName~Taxi.Api.Tests.<Area> fragment. NO .claude/schemas/work-items.v1.json file exists (known scaffold gap per CLAUDE.md); this matches the operative UC-002/003/004 handoff shape the conductor consumes. ============ RECONCILIATION 1 - routes/common vs routes/available (LOAD-BEARING): The SOURCE (api ListCommonRoutesEndpoint) already exposes routes/common as AllowAnonymous, fleet-by-slug via TenantResolutionMiddleware, AsNoTracking + query-filter-scoped, unwrapping a named { routes } envelope, returning id/name/type/priceCzk (+ PointToPoint pickup/dropoff coords/addresses) filtered by Europe/Prague valid-now (validNow=true). The UC-004 web client ALREADY calls getCommonRoutes() -> GET /routes/common?validNow=true and unwraps data.routes (web client.ts, web useCommonRoutes.ts - both verified). DECISION: routes/common IS the canonical public valid-now route listing; the assignment's GET routes/available is SATISFIED-BY it (superset shape - the assignment's fromLabel/toLabel are covered by name + the existing pickup/dropoff addresses). Do NOT add a second endpoint and do NOT rename - ZERO client migration on the routes side. A5-routes-crud adds the admin CRUD under the same RoutesFeatureConfiguration and MUST NOT touch ListCommonRoutesEndpoint. Documented in decisions.md by A6. ============ RECONCILIATION 2 - pricing/quote REPLACED (LOAD-BEARING, forces a Lane-B client migration): The SOURCE (api QuoteEndpoint) is GET + CustomerOnly, QuoteResponse(PriceType, FixedPriceCzk, EstimateLowCzk, EstimateHighCzk) with NO Meter branch, no routeId/routeName on Fixed, no distanceKm/durationMin on Estimate, and a no-dropoff -> wide-Estimate behavior.
